name: Protectorate General to Pacify the North
wikipedia: Protectorate General to Pacify the North

predecessors.name: Xueyantuo
predecessors.text: 'the former territory of the Xueyantuo', which thirteen Tiele and Uyghur tribes gave up on 9 January 647

successors.name: Second Turkic Khaganate
successors.text: the Mongolian Plateau, which the protectorate 'controlled from 647 to 682'; Ilterish founded the Second Turkic Khaganate by revolt in 682

capitals.name: Yanran (Anbei seat on the Mongolian steppe)

ledger.x: 663: the Yanran Protectorate becomes the Hanhai Protectorate ('On 5 February 663 the Yanran Protectorate' was renamed); in August 669 it becomes the Protectorate General to Pacify the North (Anbei).
669: the Hanhai Protectorate is renamed the Protectorate General to Pacify the North (Anbei) in August 669.

wars.name: Revolt of Ilterish and the Second Turkic Khaganate
wars.outcome: Ilterish Qaghan founded the Second Turkic Khaganate by revolt in 682 and the Tang lost the Mongolian Plateau.

certainty.note: Steppe frontier, bounded only by Baikal, the Gobi, the Greater Khingan and the Altai on the page.
